history.note: Season-opening squad -- the model's own GW1 recommendation (reports/gw1_recommendation.md). Two human judgment calls are baked in here: Haaland was force-included over the pure optimizer's pick (cost: ~4.65 projected points over GW1-4, per the report), and Shaw was swapped for Cash on the bench over transfer-market risk to his starting spot (same price, no data signal yet -- see the report's addendum). Every decision from gameweek 2 onward is the model acting alone.
